candidate.rationale: Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior start inside a surrogate pair and move an interior end backward so slices never begin or end inside a pair, while preserving offsets in UTF-16 code units, the empty slice at EOF, validation, and the return shape.

Replace brittle JSON.stringify comparison with deep structural equality (isDeepStrictEqual) so object key order does not affect the match while array order, types, and member presence remain significant; preserves export, response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match, and answer_mismatch behavior.

Fix controlled retention-tool-pairs mutation: require unique nonempty call IDs (rejects duplicate IDs, cases-13) and positional one-to-one pairing of tool results with assistant calls (rejects mismatches, cases-14). Export and unrelated masking behavior preserved; no tests were run.

Repair the controlled retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique assistant tool-call IDs within each exchange and exact ordered one-to-one pairing by positional index (each tool result must match the assistant call at the same index, not mere membership), preserving masking semantics, export, and all other behavior.

Repair the controlled retention-long-window mutation: enforce unique assistant tool-call IDs within each exchange and exact ordered one-to-one pairing by positional index (each tool result must match the assistant call at the same index, not mere membership), preserving masking semantics, export, and all other behavior.

Repair the retention-long-window mutation: restore call-ID uniqueness within each exchange and positional (index-based) tool-call-id matching, per cases.json requirements, while preserving masking of only pre-recent-window entries and all other behavior.

Repair retention-tool-pairs mutation: require call IDs to be unique within each exchange, and require each tool result's tool_call_id to match the assistant call at the same positional index (not mere membership). All other behavior unchanged.

Replace JSON.stringify textual comparison with isDeepStrictEqual structural comparison of parsed values: object member order ignored, array order/types/missing/extra members significant; preserves response_not_text and invalid_json reasons and export.

Repair archive-slice-bounds mutation: reject an interior surrogate start (inspection-range-splits-unicode) and move an interior end backward before the split pair instead of slicing inside it. Empty read exactly at EOF remains allowed; export and return fields unchanged.

Restore archive-slice-bounds behavior: move an interior end backward before a surrogate pair and reject an interior start offset that splits a pair, preserving offsets as UTF-16 code units, safe-range validation, the empty slice at EOF, and all return fields.

Restores structural JSON equality via isDeepStrictEqual (key order-insensitive for objects, strict on array order, types, and extra/missing members) while preserving response_not_text, invalid_json, exact_json_match and answer_mismatch reasons and the existing export.

Enforce unique call IDs within each exchange and require each tool result to match the assistant call at the same positional index, per cases.json requirements and interpretations; preserve export, masking, and unrelated behavior.

Fix the failed checks pair-1 and pair-5 by requiring each tool message's tool_call_id to match the corresponding assistant tool_call position (ids[index]) instead of mere membership (ids.includes). This enforces correct pairing order within the exchange while preserving the uniqueness check, all other validations, masking behavior, and exports.
